newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Oct 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Oct 20.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has said her govermnemnt believes in "non-communal" politics, and urged people to practice their respective religion with liberty.
At least two barge-mounted power plants, each with 100-150 megawatt capacity, will be set up in next one year by private generators to meet the emergency electricity needs.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has said the government is determined to check cross-border smuggling.
Bangladesh's import declined by 14.77 percent during the first two months of the current fiscal 1996/97 (July-June) compared with the same period last year, central bank said.
